New project study offer!

Current Project Study Offerings

We are looking for students who are interested in a project study in the field of customer success at Ark Climate (https://www.ark-climate.de/), a climate tech start-up that develops climate protection software for cities in Germany.

Project Study

If you plan to conduct your project studies in cooperation with the Professorship for Economics of Innovation,  you can choose between the following options:

  1. Apply with your own proposal which comprises the following documents (pdf) attached to an email to office.eoi[at]wi.tum.de
    • Exposé: Description of the project naming the company, the product/goal, duration, period and participants.
    • Project study registration form (see below): Prefill it as much as possible.
  2. In case there is an open project study topic advertised on this page, apply for it at the indicated contact.
